class.name: SpacetimeDBIdentity
class.brief_description: A 256-bit identity used by SpacetimeDB to identify users.
class.description: SpacetimeDBIdentity wraps the 32-byte (256-bit) identity value that SpacetimeDB assigns to each connected user. Identities persist across connections and can be serialized as hex strings or raw bytes.

method.name: create_zero
method.description: Creates a zero (anonymous) identity with all bytes set to 0.

method.name: create_from_bytes
method.description: Creates an identity from raw bytes.

method.name: create_from_hex
method.description: Creates an identity from a hex string representation.

method.name: is_zero
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if all bytes of the identity are zero.

method.name: is_equal
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this identity is equal to [param other].

members.member: The identity as a hexadecimal string.
